title: Tool 64 — Chain Privacy Topology Visualizer
description: Visualize Hyperledger Fabric PDC topology and Canton sub-transaction privacy models. Parse configtx.yaml PDC definitions or Canton party-to-participant mapping to produce a color-coded visibility heatmap: teal=fully private, amber=partially visible, red=overexposed. Client-side. Zero PII.
